status: specification-only; no runnable simulation or native/provider tests executed
fixture_policy: Scenario declarations require concrete schemas, candidate versions, numeric budgets and runnable adapters in R06/R07. Cases with unresolved policies stay blocked, never assigned an invented outcome.

traceability.model: document-model-spec.md: DM-01–DM-15, especially single ownership and coherent effects
traceability.api: command-api-spec.md and model-api-contract-cases.json: internal reconciliation uses shared owners
traceability.product: sync-and-portability.md and acceptance-matrix.md: provider-specific release gates

scenarios.title: Opt-in isolation
scenarios.initial: Local-only Space has new content.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Save with transport disabled.
scenarios.expected: Local save succeeds without provider traffic or an unbounded disabled-provider queue.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Network access or remote dependency for ordinary save.

scenarios.title: Join baseline race
scenarios.initial: Local and remote states exist.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Change remote state during listing/baseline capture.
scenarios.expected: Catch-up discovers every committed state via replay or safe rescan.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Silently missing a state between listing and cursor capture.

scenarios.title: Wrong Space
scenarios.initial: Bound Space A receives a valid package for B.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Attempt ingestion.
scenarios.expected: Reject/quarantine without changing A.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Implicitly joining B or rewriting identities.

scenarios.title: Account switch
scenarios.initial: Account A has pending uploads.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Rebind to B then deliver an old A callback.
scenarios.expected: Binding generation isolates callbacks and preserves pending local work; explicit join/create policy applies.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Publishing A data into B by stale callback.

scenarios.title: Disable in flight
scenarios.initial: Upload/read is active.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Disable then finish its callback.
scenarios.expected: No new transfer starts; stale callbacks cannot reactivate the binding; local work remains.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Claiming remote erasure or discarding pending content.

scenarios.title: Duplicate and reorder
scenarios.initial: Two competing states and repeated manifests.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Deliver every permutation twice to fresh replicas.
scenarios.expected: Same current and retained losing states, no publication echo.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Arrival-order winner or duplicate history effects.

scenarios.title: Clock skew
scenarios.initial: Replica wall clocks differ drastically.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Publish concurrent states with chosen logical keys.
scenarios.expected: Winner follows the specified deterministic key, with honest user meaning.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Using file mtime as authoritative latest.

scenarios.title: Causal descendant
scenarios.initial: B descends from A.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Deliver B before A then replay A.
scenarios.expected: B remains current once dependencies are valid.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Delayed ancestor replaces its descendant.

scenarios.title: Identity fork
scenarios.initial: A known commit ID has bytes X.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Receive same ID with different bytes Y.
scenarios.expected: Reject fork and retain diagnostic/provenance safely.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Treating Y as harmless retry.

scenarios.title: Missing dependency
scenarios.initial: Manifest references an absent parent.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Disconnect before fetching parent.
scenarios.expected: Durably pending state retries without unsafe visibility.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Applying an unvalidated dependency graph.

scenarios.title: Manifest before media
scenarios.initial: Referenced PDF has not arrived.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Deliver manifest first and interrupt download.
scenarios.expected: Missing-media state is explicit; required closure is not falsely complete.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Reporting full availability or collecting the outstanding media root.

scenarios.title: Interrupted publication
scenarios.initial: Local outbox contains a coherent effect set.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Fail between payload upload and commit publication.
scenarios.expected: Retry immutable objects and publish only a complete discoverable commit.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Partial package interpreted as complete.

scenarios.title: Lost upload reply
scenarios.initial: Provider accepted unique package.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Lose response and restart client.
scenarios.expected: Retry recognizes the same object or verifies identity; no second semantic commit.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Duplicate tasks or contradictory bytes under one ID.

scenarios.title: Cursor crash
scenarios.initial: Fetched input is not yet ingested.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Crash around pending-record and cursor writes.
scenarios.expected: Replay or durable pending record preserves every discovered input.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Cursor advances past unrecorded work.

scenarios.title: Disjoint documents
scenarios.initial: Two replicas edit unrelated notes.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Reconcile in both orders.
scenarios.expected: Both edits survive independently.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Whole-Space latest-wins losing an unrelated note.

scenarios.title: Concurrent task moves
scenarios.initial: Task t is initially in note A.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Offline replicas move t to B and C.
scenarios.expected: Selected algorithm converges to one placement with coherent bodies/history; until selected this is blocked.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Two placements, dangling blocks or pretending pending is a release solution.

scenarios.title: Delete versus move
scenarios.initial: Note A owns task t.
scenarios.action_or_fault: One replica deletes A while another moves t to B.
scenarios.expected: Chosen ownership/delete policy converges and preserves losing history; exact outcome specified before execution.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Independent per-note winners duplicate or silently lose t.

scenarios.title: Restore moved task
scenarios.initial: Historical A owned t; current B owns t.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Restore A while receiving concurrent B state.
scenarios.expected: Explicit identity-safe restore policy preserves unique placement.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Historical restore steals or duplicates t implicitly.

scenarios.title: Repeat generation
scenarios.initial: Recurring task occurrence is complete offline on two replicas.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Deliver both completion/generation effects repeatedly.
scenarios.expected: One next occurrence per series slot under specified recurrence reconciliation.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Two next occurrences or a regenerated old body.

scenarios.title: Stale offline resurrection
scenarios.initial: A deleted identity has an offline replica.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Compact then rejoin with an old state.
scenarios.expected: Retention/retirement proof prevents resurrection or requires safe baseline rejoin.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Timer-only tombstone removal revives deleted work.

scenarios.title: Missing transport file
scenarios.initial: A local note is healthy.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Provider returns missing file or permission loss.
scenarios.expected: Preserve local content and expose blocked/incomplete transport status.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Interpreting absence as a domain delete.

scenarios.title: Losing history arrives late
scenarios.initial: Winner is already current.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Receive an older competing state with media.
scenarios.expected: Durably retain recoverable losing closure according to declared history scope.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Discarding the late loser because it cannot win.

scenarios.title: Pin versus cleanup
scenarios.initial: Pinned state and pending outbox share media.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Race cleanup against new root acquisition.
scenarios.expected: Root fencing retains reachable content through local/promised transport scope.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Check-once deletion races a pin or upload.

scenarios.title: iCloud placeholder/status
scenarios.initial: Package files are placeholders or still uploading.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Observe native events and lose network.
scenarios.expected: Download/availability/transfer status reflect actual scoped evidence; no blocking poll in coordinated read.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Local write reported as confirmed all-device sync.

scenarios.title: Drive scope and revocation
scenarios.initial: Least-access OAuth client selects target folder.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Discover collaborator-created package then revoke token.
scenarios.expected: Actual scope access is measured; local save remains available and token failures are actionable.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Assuming descendant access or broadening scope silently.

scenarios.title: Drive polling lifetime
scenarios.initial: No HTTPS receiving service is configured.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Stop/resume active client around remote changes.
scenarios.expected: Poll/catch-up within declared running-client budget and persist progress.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Claiming documented push works without required receiver.

scenarios.title: Windows route gate
scenarios.initial: Mac native iCloud candidate exists.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Attempt Windows visibility/download qualification.
scenarios.expected: Record real exact-route evidence or block Windows support claim.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Treating iCloud client installation as app-container proof.

scenarios.title: Headless catch-up
scenarios.initial: CLI saves while no desktop window exists.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Exit all capable processes then restart one.
scenarios.expected: Local durability/outbox preserved; transfer resumes with honest process-lifetime status.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Making note creation await cloud or claiming core ingestion while no process runs.

scenarios.title: Untrusted package
scenarios.initial: External manifest includes traversal, cycles or oversized input.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Submit bounded adversarial corpus.
scenarios.expected: Reject before unsafe decoding/path access; record bounded redacted diagnostics.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Executing embedded content, leaking tokens or unbounded graph allocation.

scenarios.title: Qualification gate
scenarios.initial: No coherent task reconciliation algorithm is accepted.
scenarios.action_or_fault: Attempt provider enablement/release qualification.
scenarios.expected: Gate stays blocked despite simulated transfer success; selected algorithm needs executable convergence/invariant proof.
scenarios.forbidden_result: Marking all SC cases passed from static drafting.
